description: This file defines the L2Tests class, which implements plugin and JSON-RPC interfaces for testing Layer 2 functionalities within the WPEFramework plugin system. It includes interface declarations, lifecycle methods (Initialize, Deinitialize, Information), and a JSON-RPC method PerformL2Tests.
